sentences: FSSM header word **0x138 = `COMPUTE_PGM_RSRC2`**: USER_SGPR [5:1], TGID_X/Y/Z_EN [9:7], TG_SIZE_EN [10], TIDIG_COMP_CNT [12:11], LDS_SIZE [23:15] in 512-byte units.

This was checked against what all 2,689 CS read before writing: 2,281 match exactly, and the rest overshoot only through loop-carried registers in the straight-line check. 0x110, which looked similar, doesn't match.
Layout: s0..user−1 = user data (push constants), then the enabled workgroup IDs (`WorkgroupId`), and v0/v1/v2 = thread ID x/y/z (`LocalInvocationId`, separate VGPRs on GFX10).
Example: the 1,013 shaders with RSRC2 `0x998` have 12 user SGPRs, group ID x/y in s12/s13, and compute x = s12·32 + v0.
Shaders with TG_SIZE_EN are rejected for now.

GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/cs_lds.asm` through `runtime/test/vk_compute_test.cpp`: 4 groups × 64 threads, LDS exchange between the two waves of a group behind `s_barrier`, store through a V# into the device-address heap, 0 mismatches.
